senses.gloss:
भय भय, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. भी), fear,
alarm, dread, apprehension (e. g. आत्म-भ्˚, fear for
one's life; मा भयं कुरु, be not afraid; cf.
दण्ड-भ्˚); dismay, fright, terror (e. g. जगद्-भ्˚,
a terror to the universe); cause for fear, danger,
peril, risk, jeopardy, hazard; the blossom of Trapa
[]
Bispinosa; (अस्), m. Fear personified as a son of
Nir-ṛti, as a prince of the Yavanas and husband of
the daughter of Time; sickness, disease; (आत्), ind.
from fear, for fear; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of
Kāla and wife of the Rākṣasa Heti.
—भय-
कम्प, अस्, m. tremor from fear, the tremor of
fear, trembling caused by fright.
—भय-कर, अस्,
ई, अम्, or भय-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, or भय-कार-
क, अस्, इका, अम्, or भय-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, fear-causing,
fear-exciting, terrifying, dangerous, perilous; fearful,
formidable, terrible.
—भयङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, =
भय-कर; (अस्), m. a small kind of owl (=
डुण्डुल); N. of one of the Viśve Devāḥ; N. of
various persons; (ई), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs
attending upon Skanda.
—भयङ्-कर्तृ, ता, त्री,
तृ, = भय-कर्तृ.
—भय-जात, अस्, m., N. of
a man.
—भय-डिण्डिम, अस्, m. ‘terror-drum,’ a
drum used in battle.
—भय-त्रातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a
deliverer from danger, rescuer from peril.
—भय-
द, अस्, आ, अम्, causing danger, inspiring fear;
वह्नि-भ्˚, causing danger from fire; (अस्), m., N.
of a king.
—भय-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, apprehensive
of danger, fearful.
—भय-दाय, अस्, आ, अम्, or
भय-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing danger, inspiring
fear; सलिल-भयदायिन्, causing danger from water.
—भय-द्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, fleeing for fear, run-
ning away in terror, routed, put to flight.
—भय-
नाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, destructive of fear or danger; (इनी),
f. a species of plant.
—भय-निमीलिताक्ष, अस्, ई,
अम्, having the eyes closed from fear.
—भय-
प्रतीकार, अस्, m. counteraction or removal of fear.
—भय-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, or भय-प्रदायिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, causing danger, inspiring fear, terrible.
—भय-प्रस्ताव, अस्, m. an occasion of alarm,
season of fear.
—भय-ब्राह्मण, अस्, m. a timid
Brāhman.
—भय-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, scattered
in terror, put to flight.
—भय-विधायिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
causing alarm, alarming, fearful.
—भय-विप्लुत,
अस्, आ, अम्, overwhelmed with fear, panic-struck.
—भय-विह्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, disturbed or agitated
with fear.
—भय-व्यूह, अस्, m. ‘array against
danger,’ a term applied to a particular mode of
marshalling an army when threatened with danger
from all sides.
—भय-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of a timo-
rous disposition, timid.
—भय-शोक-समाविष्ट,
अस्, आ, अम्, affected with fear and grief, filled with
sorrow and dismay.
—भय-संहृष्ट-रोमन्,
आ, आ, अ, having the hair erect with terror, horrified.
—भय-सन्त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, terrified by danger,
scared with terror.
—भयसन्त्रस्त-मानस, अस्,
आ, अम्, having the mind scared with terror.
—भय-
स्थ, Ved. a perilous position, dangerous situation.
—भय-स्थान, अम्, n. an occasion of alarm, cause
of apprehension or fear.
—भयस्थान-शत, आनि,
n. pl. hundreds of occasions of fear.
—भय-हर्तृ,
ता, त्री, तृ, or भय-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, re-
moving or dispelling fear, a remover of fear.
—भ-
य-हेतु, उस्, m. a cause for fear or alarm, danger.
—भयातुर (˚य-आत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, distressed with
fear, agitated with alarm.
—भयान्वित (˚य-अन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, filled with fear, frightened, alarmed.
—भयापह (˚य-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, warding off
fear or danger; a prince, king.
—भयाबाध
(˚य-अब्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, undisturbed by fear, unex-
posed to danger.
—भयार्त (˚य-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
distressed with fear, alarmed, terrified, frightened,
afraid.
—भयावह (˚य-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, bring-
ing fear or danger, causing alarm, formidable, fearful.
—भयैक-प्रवण (˚य-एक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, wholly
inclined to the one (feeling) fear, wholly filled with
alarm, wholly absorbed or engrossed by fear.
—भ-
योत्तर (˚य-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, attended with or
succeeded by fear; [cf. उत्तर.]
—भयोपशम
(˚य-उप्˚), अस्, m. soothing or allaying fear, en-
couraging.
भय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be feared.

भयमान, अस्, m., Ved., N. of the author of
the hymn Ṛg-veda I. 100.

भयानक, अस्, आ, अम् (probably fr. भयान,
an old anomalous present part. A. of rt. 1. भी),
fearful, frightful, formidable, terrible, terrific, horrible;
(अम्), n. terror; (अस्), m. a tiger; Rāhu or the
[]
Ascending Node personified; the Rasa or sentiment
of terror as excited by poetical or dramatic compo-
sition.
—भयानक-ता, f. or भयानक-त्व, अम्,
n. fearfulness, formidableness.
—भयानक-रस-
निर्देश, अस्, m., N. of the 144th chapter of the
Śārṅgadhara-paddhati.

भायजात्य भायजात्य, अस्, m. (fr. भय-
जात), a patronymic of Kapi-vana; of Nikothaka.
